$comment: Generated from pipeline/snowlight/schemas by `uv run python -m snowlight.schemas`. Do not edit.

DirectoryStamp.description:
The directory a file's school and district indexes point into.

It must equal generated_on, count and the number of districts of the
schools/meta.json the reader has loaded; otherwise the file is ignored.
DirectoryStamp.title: DirectoryStamp

LocalDate.description: A calendar day in the school's own time zone: YYYY-MM-DD.

OpenStatement.description:
A school's explicit word that it runs as normal on a local day.

It never lights the map. The prediction model reads it as "school is held that
day": the chance of no school drops to near zero, leaving at most a small chance
of an early dismissal.

at.description: When the statement was first seen.

confidence.description: The status reader's confidence in the statement (0.9 or more), or null.

OpenStatement.title: OpenStatement

Probability.description: A chance from 0 to 1, in hundredths (0.07, not 0.0734).

SchemaVersion.description: The file format's version. A reader refuses a file with any other.

SchoolIndex.description: A school's position in schools/meta.json ids (and in points.bin).

UtcInstant.description: A moment in UTC, whole seconds: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

description:
live/opens.json: the open statements in force, written beside live/closings.json.

It carries the same generated_at and directory stamp as the closings file of the
same publish. A school-day appears at most once, and never on a day that file
shows a status for.

opens.description: Sorted by day, then school; one per school and day.

title: OpensFile
